policy: This manifest stores only non-secret evidence references and hashes. Credentials, learner data, OAuth values, capabilities, protected answers, raw logs and recordings remain in the approved external evidence store.

entries.scope: Claude TLS, OAuth metadata, privacy, unauthenticated MCP challenge, Origin boundary and fail-closed routes
entries.note: The operator supplied a passing terminal transcript for the retired ID-file candidate. It is historical only and must be rerun against the final first-party 24-hour-session candidate before it can become release evidence.

entries.scope: Frozen OpenAI V1 runtime checks and production readiness after Claude activation
entries.note: The operator supplied a passing terminal transcript in the working session. It is not durable release evidence until an external evidence ID, content hash and approver are recorded.

entries.scope: Initial Claude.ai custom-connector flow and two learning-goal interactions
entries.note: The Product Owner reported a successful real-Claude smoke test for the retired ID-file candidate. It is historical only and does not cover the final first-party 24-hour-session candidate, all twelve tools and both UI resources.

entries.scope: Technical source and digest of the 512x512 portal icon candidate
entries.note: Technical provenance remains in the repository, but the final candidate digest, portal rendering, trademark rights and explicit Product Owner and Legal approval must be recorded after the candidate is tested.

entries.scope: First-party Claude launch creates one opaque spc_ learner session valid for exactly 24 hours; missing, expired and replayed sessions fail closed
entries.note: Run and approve this evidence only against the final tested candidate.

entries.scope: Connector OAuth, MCP, first-party Web launch, logs and hosted-Claude output contain neither permanent SkillPilot ID nor encrypted ID-file material
entries.note: Run and approve this evidence only against the final tested candidate.

entries.scope: Long-lived connector OAuth and offline_access remain transport-only and cannot contain, select, mint, renew or extend a learner session
entries.note: Run and approve this evidence only against the final tested candidate.

entries.scope: Three to five sanitized PNG carousel images from the real SkillPilot Claude MCP Apps, each at least 1000 pixels wide, paired with its prompt and approved by Product, QA and Legal
entries.note: The repository carousel is reproducible from synthetic authorized-adult fixture data. Product, QA and Legal must approve the final candidate images and bind durable evidence to the frozen submission candidate before this gate can pass.
